Histone modification readers regulate the DNA damage repair pathway

Histone modification readers regulate the DNA damage repair pathway. Histone modification readers regulate the NHEJ and HR DNA damage repair pathways. As outlined, BRD proteins regulate Ku loading by binding Ku 70 and Ku 80, end resection by interaction with CtIP, and recruitment of HR elements through interplay with Rad51 and RPA. BRD protein, bromodomain protein; CtIP, c-terminal binding protein; DNA-PKcs, DNA-dependent protein kinase catalytic subunit; NHEJ, non-homologous end joining; HRR, homologous recombination repair
